title: Lipase

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Lipase is a digestive enzyme that helps the body digest fats. Most of it is made by the pancreas, and some by the salivary glands and stomach.
context: Fasting may be asked for before the test. Many medicines, including codeine, water pills (diuretics), some cholesterol medicines and birth control pills, can affect lipase levels.
aboveRange: Inflammation of the pancreas or a blocked pancreatic duct
Some kidney or salivary gland conditions
belowRange: Long-term conditions that reduce how much lipase the pancreas makes
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
